headline: ACC announces commissioning of a new project
summary: ACC Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about the successful commissioning of a new project. Such operational updates indicate progress on the company's capital expenditure plans. While financial details were not immediately disclosed, project completions can incrementally impact production capacity. Indian retail investors tracking cement stocks should note this operational milestone.
why_it_matters: Operational capacity rises for ACC, supporting future volume growth.

headline: Ambuja Cements submits scrutinizer report for NCLT-convened shareholder meeting on ACC amalgamation
hook: ACC merger moves closer to final approval
summary: Ambuja Cements has submitted the combined scrutinizer's report following the NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders. The meeting was held pursuant to an Ahmedabad bench order regarding the scheme of amalgamation of ACC Limited into Ambuja Cements. Shareholders voted on the merger proposal as part of the corporate consolidation process. Indian retail investors holding shares in either entity should track the final NCLT clearance timeline.
why_it_matters: Corporate consolidation brings Ambuja and ACC closer to a single entity.
winners_losers: Ambuja holders gain / structural consolidation proceeds
